description.value:
These stylish yet menacing thigh-high heeled boots sparkle with tiny glass gems and feature silver studs shaped like scorpion claws that wrap around the toe. On the back, a silver stinger acts as a decorative spur. You gain a +2 item bonus to Intimidation checks while wearing the boots.

Activate—Startling Stinger 2 (emotion, fear, illusion, manipulate, mental, visual)

Frequency once per day

Effect You tap the toes of the boots together, causing an illusory scorpion to peel away from each. Creatures adjacent to you must attempt a @Check[will|dc:25|traits:emotion,fear,illusion,manipulate,mental,visual] save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Frightened]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The creature is frightened 1 and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Fleeing] for 1 round.

Critical Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Frightened]{Frightened 2} and fleeing for as long as it remains frightened.
